newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers ease with low demand, barge selling.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers ease with low demand, barge selling.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices eased on Tuesday with low demand and some concerted barge market selling, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 cst fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $95/$96 fob as the barge market reached trades as low as $93 ex-wharf. One Rotterdam-based trader sold some 15,000 tonnes of barges in the morning.
Total ARA bunker demand remained low, at little more than 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices followed Rotterdam slightly lower. Supplies were healthy and demand, as in Rotterdam, was low.
The Mediterranean market remained fairly dormant. Prices changed little except in France where some suppliers responded to Rotterdam's weakness.
